en.headline: 9 own commits across two repositories
en.summary: **9 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, with 2 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 5 commits documented V2 skill discovery and master-agent orchestration, user-tested results for an AI-detection reduction checklist, a Chinese rewrite of that checklist with unverified items and side effects noted, corrected WorkBuddy session-directory encoding rules, and measured WorkBuddy host/CLI boundaries, model access, and session data. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 4 commits added `--help` and `-h` to usage text, updated the assertion count from 279 to 333 after `scripts/daily/verify.mjs` passed all 333 checks, documented the `--help` flag and unknown-parameter exit code 3 on the English and Chinese install pages, and added `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` to the English and Chinese `<config>` resolution order. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 9 次本人提交
zh.summary: **9 次本人提交**分布于 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`，另有 2 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 5 次提交中，记录了 V2 技能发现与主从代理编排、降 AI 检测清单的用户实测结果、该清单的中文改写及未验证项与副作用标注、WorkBuddy 会话目录编码规则修正，以及 WorkBuddy 宿主/CLI 边界、模型接入与会话数据实测。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 4 次提交中，用法文本补充了 `--help` 与 `-h`，断言数由 279 更新为 333（`scripts/daily/verify.mjs` 实跑 333 项全绿），英中安装页补充了 `--help` 与未知参数退出码 3，并在英中 `<config>` 解析顺序中加入 `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`。当日没有 pull request、issue、review、发布或讨论记录。
